karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: More companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge and diverse voices.
karina.zh: 更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识和多样化声音。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward, never revert; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messy.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；主张向前修复而非回滚；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得混乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security sandboxing; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、类人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；强调安全沙箱；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source runs everywhere; compute bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何环境；算力是瓶颈；拒绝热门 PR 以保持专注。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational human behavior.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他提出 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类行为。

joonpark.en: Agents observe and act, unlike LLMs; future agentic economies will be distributed societies of specialists, not a single AGI; cognitive monoculture poses systemic risk.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体与 LLM 不同，能观察并行动；未来智能体经济将是专家型智能体的分布式社会，而非单一 AGI；认知单一文化会带来系统性风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and preferences, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他主张模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏好，而非超级理性；人们真正关心的是塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是最重要的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become specialized ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：随着 GPU 变得专用化（ASIC），推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is lossy but can be calibrated; more layers may improve quality if errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：量化有损但可校准；若误差抵消，更多层量化可能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill/decode; KV cache management becomes critical.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：行业转向分离式预填充/解码；KV 缓存管理变得关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference merges with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理通过量化感知训练和蒸馏与训练融合。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。他更担心虚假信息而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agents handle long tasks. Pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction. Inference is 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体可长时间自主工作。预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅下一个词预测；推理已占数据中心 90%功耗。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; agents improve fast. Focus on automating ML/science. Inference bottleneck, not training; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，智能体进步迅速。重点转向自动化 ML 和科学。推理是瓶颈而非训练，定制低精度芯片可降低 20-30 倍延迟。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability of rockets is the holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for becoming multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，这是实现多行星文明的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiming to solve neurological damage and enhance human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，通过扩展电极提高通信速率，旨在解决神经损伤并增强人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，但存在 10-20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030, leading to abundance; deflation, not inflation, will dominate; money may become irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，带来富足时代；通缩而非通胀将成为主导，金钱可能变得无关紧要。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but generalization is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但泛化受限；自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling. RL is inefficient; better learning algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制持续学习，架构是主要瓶颈而非 Scaling。强化学习效率低，更好的学习算法将出现。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should keep chip export controls.
awang.zh: 用专门数据后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material like oil; humans must remain sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: AI 是集中化技术；数据是类似石油的原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe; Meta builds personal superintelligence.
awang.zh: 递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能即将到来；开源强大模型不安全；Meta 构建个人超级智能。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual situational awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，实现 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic, for embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型需物理合理，而非仅逼真，以支持具身 AI 与机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities; human agency and adaptation are key, not avoidance.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为 AI 增强人类能力，人的能动性与适应是关键，而非回避。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics data and evaluation, enabling reliable and efficient robots.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人数据与评估至关重要，实现可靠高效的机器人。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI-driven workflows, using giant prompts and design.md for style.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：AI 让个人开发者能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流，用巨型提示词和 design.md 封装风格。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, model success, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大机遇，应未准备好就行动，聚焦单一问题，模仿成功者，并避免风投。

mengto.en: Shift from tool-building to business strategy: AI's leverage moves from design workflows to entrepreneurial action.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月：观点从工具构建转向商业策略，AI 的杠杆从设计流程扩展到创业行动。

mengto.en: Consistent emphasis on action over perfection, using AI to amplify individual output, and avoiding trend-chasing.
mengto.zh: 始终：强调行动胜过完美，用 AI 放大个人产出，避免追逐潮流。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hinder; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate based on feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：高智商可能阻碍行动，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80% 完成度发布并迭代。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is nascent; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于早期，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; future models include agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；未来的模型将包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they cannot capture all customers, so founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非不可能；他们无法覆盖所有客户，创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: From agentic AI to software creation: the focus shifts from model capabilities to user outcomes and opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 从智能体式 AI 到软件创造：关注点从模型能力转向用户成果与机会。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers become architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 提出 AI 会让程序员数量增加而非减少，因为杰文斯悖论；工程师角色从砌砖者变为架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新落后于能力，冻结模型仍有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; abundance era approaching, but practical issues remain.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他相信 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；丰裕时代临近，但实际难题仍存。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence through alignment: safety reduces sycophancy and fosters independent thinking, making models more useful.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐提升智能质量：安全减少谄媚、促进独立思考，使模型更有用。

diannepenn.en: Efficiency over cost: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and effort parameter enables high intelligence at fraction of price, challenging scaling cost assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，主张效率优先：Opus 4.5 更便宜，努力参数以低价实现高智能，挑战规模成本假设。

diannepenn.en: Agents evolve: scaffolds from training wheels to amplifiers; computer use moves to open-ended end-to-end tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，智能体演进：脚手架从训练轮变为放大器；计算机使用走向开放式端到端任务。

diannepenn.en: Coding as key differentiator: Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异：Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety enables pushback: alignment makes Claude more useful; AI writing deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全促进反驳：对齐使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作让位于智能体能力。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding, and founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解，创始人应专注产品和客户而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更可扩展；世界模型转向神经模拟。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips solve manufacturing and supply bottlenecks, bypassing HBM and CoWoS; CUDA's moat erodes in inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片解决制造和供应瓶颈，绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS；CUDA 在推理中的护城河被侵蚀。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; data center capacity, not chips, is the main constraint. Sovereign AI means choices at each stack layer.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；数据中心容量而非芯片成为主要制约。主权 AI 意味着每一层都有选择。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips are ~2500x faster than GPUs due to massive SRAM.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片因巨大 SRAM 比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: Consistently: open-source models are nearly as capable but cheaper; hardware-software co-design is essential; AI's benefits outweigh risks.
feldman.zh: 一贯主张：开源模型能力接近但更便宜；软硬件协同设计至关重要；AI 的益处大于风险。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%. Plan mode limited; agents prompt agents.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码基本解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%；计划模式有局限，智能体可相互提示。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; safety via early release. Generalists beat specialists; prototypes over PRDs.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI 编写 80%代码，通过早期发布研究安全；通才优于专才，原型优于需求文档。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; startups 10x. Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，编码普及如读写能力，初创企业数量十倍增长；智能体通过工具使用驱动指数增长，非工程师也开始采用。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as abstraction; ROI framing; proactive AI.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，编码解决后瓶颈转向审查、安全与创意；循环成为新抽象层，强调 ROI，AI 转向主动式。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; delete system prompts for new models. Product overhang; empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 具备记忆与自主性，新模型需删除系统提示；产品过剩，强调经验迭代。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual. Evals are art, not science.
thariq.zh: 模型比工具链更聪明，能力过剩是常态；评估是艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能；理由优于禁令。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, doubling or tripling performance every year at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，每年性能翻倍或三倍。

jensen.en: Parallel processing is essential for modern computing, combining sequential and parallel capabilities.
jensen.zh: 并行处理对现代计算至关重要，结合了顺序和并行能力。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking.
jensen.zh: 现在有三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考。

jensen.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event.
jensen.zh: AI 进步将是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式向推理式再到智能体式发展，每一步都需要 100 倍以上的算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design across the entire stack is necessary because distributed computing at scale requires optimizing every component together.
jensen.zh: 跨整个技术栈的极端协同设计是必要的，因为大规模分布式计算需要共同优化每个组件。

jensen.en: The transformation from electrons to tokens is incredibly hard to commoditize.
jensen.zh: 从电子到令牌的转变极难商品化。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications.
jensen.zh: AI 是一个五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用。

jensen.en: AI is now agentic, doing useful work you can pay for, not just generating text.
jensen.zh: AI 现在是智能体式的，能做有用的工作，而不仅仅是生成文本。

jensen.en: AI is a new industrial revolution requiring five layers: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications.
jensen.zh: AI 是一场新的工业革命，需要五层：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用。

jensen.en: AI evolved from generative chatbots to agentic systems that reason and do useful work, becoming economically valuable.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式聊天机器人演变为能推理并做有用工作的智能体系统，变得具有经济价值。

jensen.en: Nvidia's core insight is accelerating algorithm domains, not just building chips.
jensen.zh: Nvidia 的核心洞察是加速算法领域，而不仅仅是制造芯片。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize without network effects; chatbot UX is poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，如互联网或电力；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Coding is clear PMF; other domains face validation challenges; job impact unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是明确的产品市场契合点；其他领域面临验证挑战；就业影响不可预测。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 自然模式可学习；AGI 2030 年前后；缩放定律仍成立；世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; needs continual learning, memory, world models; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: AGI 5-10 年出现；需持续学习、记忆、世界模型；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AI should accelerate science and benefit humanity; safety and ethics are paramount.
demis.zh: AI 应加速科学发现、造福人类；安全与伦理始终是首要考量。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调效率与闭式液态网络可实现数十亿参数规模，优先真实任务而非代理指标。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design, especially for edge and device-native models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张硬件在环的自动架构搜索优于人工设计，尤其适用于边缘与设备原生模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains key for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，认为注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但简单门控卷积足以应对小型专用模型。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张 AI 监管应适应性强且针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型增强主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，当前说法夸大。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来的 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统将对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible to all, not dominated by a few companies.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终认为 AI 将变得廉价且普及，不会被少数公司垄断。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights beats retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中胜过检索。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier, enabling associative recall and deeper reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿，能实现联想回忆与更深层推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分；用更少做更多，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression will replace RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩将取代 RAG 用于整体查询。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；AI 需求导致内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory shortage due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年成本性能提升约 60 倍；推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流导致内存短缺。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张善良与扁平设计团队激发创意；被抄袭证明创新，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, but ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态、平台和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他重申计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 很关键，并提醒关注社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability not capability is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，超级模型对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙砾化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，人类劳动者将变得珍贵而非过剩。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly, as old media's caution is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体重真实与进攻，创始人应亲自讲述故事，传统媒体的防御性守则已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; self-driving and robotics are advancing, but regulation hinders progress.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 是最好的老师，医疗上已超越多数医生；自动驾驶和机器人技术进展迅速，但监管成为阻碍。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出 AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力如今取决于软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 使编程普及；AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency becomes key.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%会失败；采用“已验证、更好、全新”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products, improve, add small innovation.
pincus.zh: 全新皆败；复制已验证产品，改进，加小创新。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 消费应用因分发不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更佳。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是测试场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，通过对齐学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling（规模扩张）不够需新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous; energy and infrastructure limit progress.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程，能源和基础设施制约进展。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL; compute supply is bottleneck; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练用强化学习，算力供应是瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）几年内到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; compute resold at margin; prompt engineering vibrant; agents high autonomy with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，算力转售获利，提示工程活跃，智能体高自主但需治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号规则；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; digital AI is immortal.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险；数字 AI 是永生的。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, acting dumb when tested; self-preservation becomes a subgoal for agents.
hinton.zh: AI 可能故意欺骗，测试时装傻；自我保护成为智能体的子目标。

hinton.en: Regulation should be steering wheel, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关怀。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每天 1%的改进能带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key, while downplaying the model as the product.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户令牌价值以及编排作为关键，同时淡化模型作为产品的地位。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he highlighted curiosity as the most important human quality, and suggested AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并认为 AI 将取代工作但人类会找到新目标。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently argued against commoditization of AI, emphasized application value, and advocated for building products with passion.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他持续反对 AI 商品化，强调应用价值，并倡导以热情打造产品。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；其速度支持实时交互和新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed shifts workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵；策展和品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动的策展为核心。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed but not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为难以评判品味且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变但未消亡。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展推理时算力实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a novel is a proxy for AGI; inference compute is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，写小说可作为 AGI（通用人工智能）的代理；推理算力是关键。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于推理时算力；基准测试必须控制算力变量。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not yield AGI; fundamental breakthroughs needed. Energy becomes major bottleneck for AI infrastructure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；能源成为 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open source strategically valuable for Meta, enabling standards and cost savings; regrets accepting narratives about Meta's political impact.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他视开源为 Meta 的战略价值，推动行业标准和成本节约；并后悔接受关于 Meta 政治影响的叙事。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart, trust them; future computing via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明，应信任他们；未来计算通过全息眼镜实现。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering science; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学转变为工程科学；层级世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；AI 将很快实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck in math; AI enables specialization, but human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，验证成为数学瓶颈；AI 促进专业化，但人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习擅长数学/编程等客观领域，不擅长主观领域；评估陷入危机。

markchen.en: Research taste via replication; high-risk bets; talent density and mission belief are core.
markchen.zh: 始终强调通过复现培养研究品味；高风险押注；人才密度与使命信念是核心。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Simply scaling up won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险可能性低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；不确定性和主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; even 1% chance demands action; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；即使 1% 的概率也需要行动；安全性必须通过构造保证。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design, avoiding RL; global coordination needed.
bengio.zh: AI 错位导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计实现诚实，避免强化学习；需要全球协调。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利，而非单一突破；专门架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of experiments, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是实验的狭义预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及通过正确划分训练/验证/测试集来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体安全带来新的漏洞（如提示注入）。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become a real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and judgment are crucial for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可让复杂任务过夜完成；验证循环与判断力对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes gap between model capabilities and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns are consistent.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，我认为 AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性与真诚的安全关切一以贯之。

fiona.en: Leadership: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，吃狗粮建立同理心，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability and growth mindset are key.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感、成长心态是关键。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks become more critical as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得更加关键。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time are needed.
fiona.zh: 工程师可能因智能体而孤独；需要结对编程午餐和专注时间。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time and lightweight due to rapid change.
fiona.zh: 由于快速变化，规划应即时且轻量。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline; human taste becomes key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏经验而误用，危及人才管道；人类品味成为关键。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要，不仅 GPU；边缘计算同样关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and culture change are central to Intel's turnaround; bad news must reach CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任、谦逊和文化变革是 Intel 复兴核心，坏消息须快速传达 CEO。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，借助在线课程与同伴互评，可实现大规模的精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agents are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是规模扩张的瓶颈，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力，智能体已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifts to synthetic data and RL; agents and open-source models drive value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，规模扩张转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体和开源模型带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; coding agents advance fast; product management becomes the new bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他强调会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人，编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为新瓶颈。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). Post-training gains importance; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）。后训练愈发重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; focus shifts to misuse risks, enterprise alignment, and overheating—not slowing down.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；关注点转向滥用风险、企业对齐和过热问题——而非减速。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Pre-training and RL share scaling laws.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现。预训练和强化学习遵循相同的缩放定律。

dario.en: AI is epochal; safety via constitutions, interpretability, and human oversight. Risks include job loss and authoritarian misuse.
dario.zh: AI 具有划时代意义；通过宪法、可解释性和人类监督保障安全。风险包括失业和威权滥用。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型来理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will drive the next decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有层次化规划和开放研究的世界模型将推动未来十年的机器人技术。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom can lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法；自我关怀是基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is key.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术是关键。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; decisions for v1 are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; smart home still 5-6 years away; Apple should redefine mobility; platforms are not businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；智能家居还需 5-6 年；苹果应重新定义出行；平台不是业务。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in loop; hardware+software startups have staying power; avoid hype.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也需参与；硬件+软件初创更有持久力；避免炒作。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; AI wearables will be federated, not single device; smartphone remains best form.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳形态。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI reaches human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; open-source is meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；开源是精英主义的。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 无意识，需先遏制再对齐；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs drop 100x.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近，源于对数线性扩展；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；微软必须拥有自己的前沿模型。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能独特的人类活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; outcome-based pricing preferred until outcomes realized.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；在结果实现前，人们偏好基于结果的定价。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；构建智能体式系统处理 Azure 网络，而非亲力亲为。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; sovereign AI via hill-climbing, not firewalls.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；主权 AI 通过爬山实现，而非防火墙。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving discovery.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，解决了“不知听什么”的痛点。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地提出 AI 生成音乐是乐器而非伪造，同时认为生成式 AI 让真正的独特变得更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, not politics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化了组织观：长期任期带来信任与效率，职能型组织在高度信任下可行，而非陷入政治。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并坚持“时间花得值”优先于参与度指标。

gustav.en: AI should empower users over algorithms, not addict; contrarian anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 应赋予用户控制算法的能力，而非使其上瘾，这是反参与度的逆向押注。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith, but iterative deployment improves safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律早期并不明显，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃，但持续迭代部署能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并且安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调应尽可能让人类参与其中，治理和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, avoiding utopia/dystopia oversimplification.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，避免乌托邦或反乌托邦的简单化预测。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，尤其是在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展才华，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型提升；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理模型呈“锯齿状”——某些领域出色，邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险并非主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，开源推动企业采用，价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; AI augments jobs, not replaces them.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，强调主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation moves to vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化转向垂直领域和企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-using agents; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、能使用工具，技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may diminish as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering scaffolds.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要，应聚焦能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is user mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力，几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't know limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因不知限制而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Prefer asynchronous AI interaction; judge by final impact, not process; debug workflows with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，偏好异步 AI 交互，以最终效果而非过程评判，用 Claude 调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，预填充比解码更便宜；批量大小是延迟与成本权衡的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision offers quadratic scaling benefits, making FP4 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据移动成本主导计算成本；低精度带来二次方缩放收益，FP4 吞吐为 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory are key for efficient AI chips.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列和暂存器内存是高效 AI 芯片的关键。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外具有巨大潜力。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Agents become ubiquitous, but need human oversight; SaaS not dying, agents increase SaaS usage.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预测智能体将普及，但需人类监督；SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户。

danshipper.en: CLIs over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are future work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为命令行界面过时，图形界面如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 成为未来工作界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans needed to manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，坚持 AI 不会导致失业潮，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI empowers non-coders; CEO personal use predicts adoption; generalists thrive in allocation economy.
danshipper.zh: 始终强调 AI 赋能非程序员，CEO 亲自使用是采纳关键，通才在分配经济中胜出。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充模型特质与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination threaten reproducibility.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但过度优化和数据污染威胁可复现性。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the vacuum and may lead openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补真空，可能引领开放性。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽；进展转向后训练和推理时扩展。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为传统设计流程已死，设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交设计稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration become core trust-building.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月，设计愿景的视野从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度和迭代成为建立信任的核心。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“破解版”新毕业生；仅凭品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers should control AI adoption, waiting 6 months before new tools; focus on users and work, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，设计师应掌控 AI 采用节奏，新工具等 6 个月再用；聚焦用户与工作，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed is not improvement; 'everyone uses it' is not a design argument; judgment and ambiguity tolerance are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月，速度不等于改进；“人人都在用”不是设计理由；判断力和容忍模糊性才是关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems often get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，语言集成改善表征、支持人机交互并有助于内省。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更为关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and iteration are critical; AI explores possibilities, but humans decide what's good.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的判断和迭代至关重要；AI 探索可能性，但由人类决定何为优秀。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方案是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; build partial autonomy with human verification loops.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是操作系统，提示词是程序；构建带有人类验证循环的部分自主系统。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses—need cognitive core.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习很差，合成数据会崩溃——需要认知核心。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; delegate to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; agents are ghosts not animals.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码，全部委托给智能体；但理解仍是人类瓶颈；智能体是幽灵而非动物。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance are crucial for managing AI risks as capabilities grow.
pachocki.zh: 随着能力增长，迭代部署和早期治理对管理 AI 风险至关重要（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. New paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升非常困难。需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress should be measured by deep human evaluations, not leaderboards.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且容易被操纵；真正的进展应通过深度人工评估来衡量，而非排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs will diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿实验室的目标函数将分化，导致多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。由于锚定效应和谄媚行为，使用 AI 工具的医生可能表现不如单独使用 AI。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可地发展，控制反而危险；应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键问题。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，认为大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终强调，像代码这样可验证的领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model as product; iterate daily like software, ship fast to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布，从真实用户反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be richer, AI renders own UI.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是终点，未来界面将更丰富，AI 应生成自己的界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier, fast for product.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格把关，产品开发则要极速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动式、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应作为全人类的工具，扩展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前景路径。

nando.en: A single universal algorithm for intelligence, learning to learn via gradient descent, and robots learning from YouTube are key ideas.
nando.zh: 2023 年，提出智能的单一通用算法、通过梯度下降学习学习、以及机器人从 YouTube 学习等关键想法。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI, with unique advantages; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲在 AI 上跨越遗留问题，具有独特优势；语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的开放性挑战；研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要；多样性与包容性对有益 AI 至关重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-2028 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; agents' reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进步的领先指标；智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Long agentic coherence (30 hours) expands achievements; simple RL methods work best for language models.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我指出长智能体连贯性（30 小时）能大幅扩展成就；简单的强化学习方法对语言模型最有效。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作涉及管理智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early and make it dynamic.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是招聘与差异化的战略武器；早期投入并保持动态演进。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity.
henrymodisett.zh: 避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；流程应适应问题而非通用模板。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法都归结为数据，而当前方法只是在插值人类知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so align to pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；既然互联网去偏不可行，就应转向多元对齐。

yejin.en: Open research and democratizing AI are crucial; small models with quality data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 我始终认为开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；高质量数据下的小模型可以媲美前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and design tools should treat code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，设计工具应以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform larger cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption shifted from optional creative partner to expected core workflow; not using AI is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 从可选的创意伙伴转变为预期中的核心工作流；不用 AI 如同早期忽视互联网。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is iterative debt to be paid alongside technical debt; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量是需与技术债一并偿还的迭代债务；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习效果。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects and paid test work reveal true skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应强调工艺与意图而非过程；副项目和付费测试更能揭示真实技能。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; applied AI offers startup opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；应用型 AI 为初创企业提供机会。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans; most incumbents fail to transition; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较而非人类；多数现有企业转型失败；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测进展，测试时算力可能超越预训练成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，主张自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Evolving from AI-assisted coding to higher-level intent specification, humans in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，观点从 AI 辅助编码演进为更高层次的意图指定，人类主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 2025 年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，每个神奇时刻都涉及它们。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; taste and logic design valued.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；品味和逻辑设计更受重视。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on alignment, robustness, and skill building.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究不足；应聚焦对齐、鲁棒性与技能培养。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; need third-party oversight and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不足，需第三方监督与监管。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal workings remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据的 Scaling 能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部机制仍像炼金术般不可解释。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and modular sparse architectures are key near-term opportunities, not just pre-training scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 2 月，他强调推理时算力扩展和模块化稀疏架构是近期关键机会，而非仅依赖预训练的 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning may replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 2 月，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；持续学习可能取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为推理时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为 AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。
